interpretation: On-policy task telemetry, not matched trials. A completed arm and finite optimizer do not establish skill or override full-match results.

semantics.censoring: Events and endings may straddle window edges. First touches divided by endings is NOT an attempt success rate.
semantics.comparison: Descriptive on-policy windows, not the same fixed states. Fresh physical entry at681 and episode-age/scenario visitation can confound trends.
semantics.evaluation: Do not substitute stochastic task rates for the completed deterministic full-match evaluation.
semantics.exposure: 30 Hz learner decisions; rates use pooled sums, not averages of rates.
semantics.kickoff: Training combines standing and momentum-assisted starts; race-first-contact is not possession.
semantics.outcomes: Goals/concedes native. Finishing success is exactly scored goals, not on-target projection.
semantics.proxies: Challenge/control and defensive clear are existing role-specific predicates, not independent possession/save proof.
